summary: Digital Realty Trust's finance subsidiary, Digital Euro Finco, LLC, priced €1 billion of 5.125% guaranteed notes due 2036 at 99.289% of par, an ordinary investment-grade debt offering disclosed under Items 7.01 and 8.01 of an October 6, 2026 Form 8-K, with the parent and operating partnership as registrants. The notes are guaranteed by Digital Realty Trust, L.P. and rank as senior unsecured obligations. No equity, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms beyond coupon, size, price, tenor, and pricing date are stated. Routine capital-markets financing, not a special situation; watch credit spreads, leverage, and funding costs.
